rows.question: 哪些站點有 C-320 這款 CT？各自收到幾件相關客訴、其中幾件已連到 CAPA？
rows.sql:
WITH c320_sites AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.site_id,
        s.name
    FROM sites s
    JOIN ct_scanners sc
      ON sc.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE sc.model = 'C-320'
)
SELECT
    cs.site_id                                   AS site_id,
    cs.name                                      AS site_name,
    COUNT(c.complaint_id)                        AS complaint_count,
    COUNT(c.capa_id)                             AS capa_linked_count
FROM c320_sites cs
LEFT JOIN ct_scanners sc
       ON sc.site_id = cs.site_id
      AND sc.model = 'C-320'
LEFT JOIN complaints c
       ON c.scanner_id = sc.scanner_id
      AND c.site_id = cs.site_id
GROUP BY
    cs.site_id,
    cs.name
ORDER BY
    cs.site_id;

rows.question: 哪些 CT 的預設切片厚度超過同站點部署版本的輸入規格上限？
rows.sql:
WITH current_deployments AS (
    SELECT
        d.serial_no,
        d.version,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.serial_no
            ORDER BY d.deployed_at DESC, d.deployment_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM deployments d
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.scanner_id,
    c.site_id,
    c.default_slice_thickness_mm AS default_slice_mm,
    cd.version AS deployed_version,
    r.max_slice_thickness_mm AS max_allowed_mm
FROM ct_scanners c
JOIN appliances a
    ON a.site_id = c.site_id
JOIN current_deployments cd
    ON cd.serial_no = a.serial_no
   AND cd.rn = 1
JOIN software_releases r
    ON r.version = cd.version
WHERE c.default_slice_thickness_mm > r.max_slice_thickness_mm;

rows.question: 醫院B 在 2026-03 到 2026-09 每個月的處理量、QC 拒收率和每例標記數？
rows.sql:
SELECT
    mu.month,
    mu.studies_processed,
    mu.qc_reject_rate,
    mu.marks_per_study
FROM monthly_usage AS mu
JOIN sites AS s
  ON s.site_id = mu.site_id
WHERE s.name = '醫院B'
  AND mu.month BETWEEN '2026-03' AND '2026-09'
ORDER BY mu.month;

rows.question: 用到 SSD 批號 SSD-S1-L2508 的主機有哪些？各在哪個站點、已經發生幾次 SSD 故障？
rows.sql:
WITH affected_serials AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ap.serial_no
    FROM appliance_parts AS ap
    JOIN part_lots AS pl
      ON pl.lot_no = ap.lot_no
    JOIN parts AS p
      ON p.part_no = ap.part_no
    WHERE pl.lot_no = 'SSD-S1-L2508'
      AND p.category = 'SSD'
)
SELECT
    a.serial_no AS serial_no,
    s.name AS site_name,
    COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS ssd_failure_count
FROM affected_serials AS af
JOIN appliances AS a
  ON a.serial_no = af.serial_no
JOIN sites AS s
  ON s.site_id = a.site_id
LEFT JOIN complaints AS c
  ON c.serial_no = a.serial_no
 AND c.category = 'hardware_failure'
 AND c.suspected_component = 'SSD'
GROUP BY
    a.serial_no,
    s.site_id,
    s.name
ORDER BY
    a.serial_no;

rows.question: 每個 SSD 批號裝在幾台主機上、其中幾台發生過 SSD 故障、比例多少？
rows.sql:
WITH ssd_lots AS (
    SELECT pl.lot_no, pl.part_no
    FROM part_lots AS pl
    JOIN parts AS p ON p.part_no = pl.part_no
    WHERE p.category = 'SSD'
)
SELECT
    sl.lot_no,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.serial_no) AS host_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN c.category = 'hardware_failure'
         AND c.suspected_component = 'SSD'
        THEN ap.serial_no
    END) AS ssd_failure_host_count,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ap.serial_no) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN c.category = 'hardware_failure'
             AND c.suspected_component = 'SSD'
            THEN ap.serial_no
        END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ap.serial_no)
    END AS failure_rate
FROM ssd_lots AS sl
LEFT JOIN appliance_parts AS ap
    ON ap.lot_no = sl.lot_no
   AND ap.part_no = sl.part_no
LEFT JOIN complaints AS c
    ON c.serial_no = ap.serial_no
GROUP BY sl.lot_no
ORDER BY sl.lot_no;

rows.question: 已公告停產的零件，在各站點還有幾台服役中的主機在用？
rows.sql:
SELECT
    s.site_id,
    s.name AS site_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.serial_no) AS in_service_appliances_using_eol_parts
FROM sites s
JOIN appliances a
    ON a.site_id = s.site_id
   AND a.status = 'in_service'
JOIN appliance_parts ap
    ON ap.serial_no = a.serial_no
JOIN parts p
    ON p.part_no = ap.part_no
   AND p.lifecycle_status = 'eol_announced'
GROUP BY
    s.site_id,
    s.name
ORDER BY
    s.site_id;

rows.question: 每台推論主機目前跑的軟體版本是什麼？
rows.sql:
WITH latest_deployment AS (
    SELECT
        serial_no,
        version,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY serial_no
            ORDER BY deployed_at DESC, deployment_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM deployments
)
SELECT
    a.serial_no,
    s.name AS site,
    ld.version AS current_version
FROM appliances a
JOIN sites s
  ON s.site_id = a.site_id
LEFT JOIN latest_deployment ld
  ON ld.serial_no = a.serial_no
 AND ld.rn = 1
ORDER BY a.serial_no;

rows.question: 還沒結案的客訴，各類別有幾件？
rows.sql:
SELECT
    category AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaints
WHERE status <> 'closed'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, category;

rows.question: 每個軟體版本目前裝在幾台主機上？
rows.sql:
WITH current_version AS (
    SELECT
        d.serial_no,
        d.version,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.serial_no
            ORDER BY d.deployed_at DESC, d.deployment_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM deployments d
    JOIN appliances a
      ON a.serial_no = d.serial_no
    WHERE a.status = 'in_service'
)
SELECT
    version AS software_version,
    COUNT(*) AS host_count
FROM current_version
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY version
ORDER BY host_count DESC, software_version;

rows.question: 目前有效的授權，各站點的年費合計是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT
    s.site_id,
    s.name AS site_name,
    SUM(l.annual_fee_twd) AS total_annual_fee_twd
FROM licenses l
JOIN sites s
  ON l.site_id = s.site_id
WHERE l.start_date <= '2026-09-30'
  AND l.end_date >= '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
    s.site_id,
    s.name
ORDER BY
    s.site_id;

rows.question: 2026 年每個月收到幾件客訴？
rows.sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT '2026-01' AS month
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-02'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-03'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-04'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-05'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-06'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-07'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-08'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-09'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-11'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2026-12'
)
SELECT
    m.month AS month,
    COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN complaints AS c
    ON substr(CAST(c.received_at AS TEXT), 1, 7) = m.month
GROUP BY m.month
ORDER BY m.month;

rows.question: 每個 CAPA 關聯了幾件客訴？

    COUNT(co.complaint_id) AS complaint_count

rows.question: 還沒核准的設計變更申請有哪些？各關聯哪個零件或軟體版本？
rows.sql:
SELECT
    cr.ecr_id,
    cr.change_type,
    cr.title,
    cr.status,
    cr.opened_at,
    cr.related_part_no,
    p.description AS part_description,
    cr.related_version,
    sr.release_date AS version_release_date
FROM change_requests AS cr
LEFT JOIN parts AS p
    ON p.part_no = cr.related_part_no
LEFT JOIN software_releases AS sr
    ON sr.version = cr.related_version
WHERE cr.status IN ('draft', 'under_review')
ORDER BY cr.opened_at, cr.ecr_id;
